references.title: it.wiktionary: bottegone
references.supports: Italian bottegone, an augmentative of bottega 'shop'; no German word

notes.rationale: The Florentine café of »wie der bei Bottegone«, a coined business name with no Core gender. No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root bottegone and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
